evidence.what_it_supports_en: An official Czech Armed Forces article dated 13 Mar 2020 documents CBRN EOD specialists from the 15th Engineer Regiment training with TALON Hazmat and Dragon Runner 10/20 Hazmat robotic systems as part of preparation for NRF 2021 certification; it reports nine specialists in that training team.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_cs: Neprokazuje současný počet specialistů, robotů, jejich organizační rozdělení, certifikační stav ani provozuschopnost v roce 2026.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_en: It does not establish the current 2026 number of specialists or robots, their organizational distribution, certification status or serviceability.

evidence.what_it_supports_cs: Oficiální záznam AČR k SMART ENGINEER 2018 popisuje štábní nácvik 153. ženijního praporu v Brně, jehož cílem bylo procvičit a ověřit činnost ženijního praporu při ženijní podpoře úkolových uskupení a rozhodovací činnost velitele a štábu. evidence.what_it_supports_en: The official Czech Armed Forces record for SMART ENGINEER 2018 describes a staff exercise of the 153rd Engineer Battalion in Brno focused on exercising and evaluating engineer-battalion support to task groups and commander/staff decision-making. It reports participation by 85 personnel from the 15th Engineer Regiment, 20 from the 7th Mechanized Brigade and 5 from a Slovak engineer battalion.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_cs: Neprokazuje současnou organizační strukturu 153. žpr, dnešní dislokaci, readiness ani dnešní brigádní C2 vztahy.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_en: It does not establish the current organization, present basing, readiness or current brigade-level C2 relationships of the 153rd Engineer Battalion.
